# contract: report.md — standard format for all repo report files
---

# Report — <Name>

> Seed for all `_report.md` files produced by `make` gates
> and maintenance helpers. Every report appends across runs
> (multi-run logger) and uses this markdown structure so the
> search TUI (`helpers/misc/search_tui.py`) can render it in
> the detail pane via `glow` or `rich.markdown`.
>
> Format rules:
> - Top heading: `# <report name> — <kind>` (H1)
> - Meta line: `**Generated:** ts · **Source:** command`
> - Tables use `| col | col |` + `|---|---|` + `| val | val |`
> - Each run/block has its own `## <header>` section
> - Verdict line: `**Verdict:** N/M · gate PASS/FAIL` (H2 or bold)
> - Severity tags in parens: `(ERROR)`, `(WARNING)`, `(OK)`
> - Append mode: each run adds a section; most recent LAST
>   (TUI defaults to last block; `--all` iterates all)

## Summary

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Generated | YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS |
| Source | `make <target>` |
| Mode | append (multi-run) |

## Latest Run

| Step / Check | Time | Status |
|---|---|---|
| <name> | <seconds>s | ✓ OK / − FAIL / ⌀ SKIP |

**Verdict:** <N/M> passed · gate <PASS/FAIL>

## Older Runs

> Each earlier run is a `## <date> <time>` section below.
> Press <key> in the TUI to browse older runs.

## Per-Step Detail

<one `## <step> (status)` section per step, with
the raw tail lines underneath>

## Notes

- Append-across-runs: each `make` invocation adds a section.
- This file is gitignored where appropriate (e.g.
  `outputs/database_integrity_report.md`).
- Generated by code, not hand-written — edit the producer,
  not this file.
